itemTooltip.sussurros.vela_palida: The wax smells like something that already died.
itemTooltip.sussurros.pagina_rasgada: The handwriting is rushed. Someone wrote this afraid.
diario.sussurros.pagina.0: Day 3. Found a good spot near the water and built a small house. All calm. Sometimes I hear footsteps behind me when I'm alone, but it must be the hills echoing.
diario.sussurros.pagina.1: Day 6. I KNOW I left three torches in the hallway. Today there were two. I started counting everything. I made a list. The list is on the wall.
diario.sussurros.pagina.2: Day 9. I heard my pickaxe down in the mine. Same rhythm, same pauses. I was lying in bed when I heard it.
diario.sussurros.pagina.3: Day 12. A silhouette on top of the hill. Too tall. Arms too long. When I looked properly, it was gone. I think it doesn't like being seen. Or it does, and it's just being polite.
diario.sussurros.pagina.4: Day 15. Beeswax, a piece of string and bone dust. The flame burns pale, almost white. It won't step where it shines. But every time I light one, it lasts less. Or it waits better.
diario.sussurros.pagina.5: Day 17. I found an eye. I don't know whose. When I hold it against the dark, I can see where the thing is. But I'm sure that when I look through the eye, it sees me too.
diario.sussurros.pagina.6: Day 20. It learns. Every time something scares me, it happens again, and again. I tried not reacting. I stood still in the dark pretending I didn't hear. I think that made it angry.
diario.sussurros.pagina.7: Day 23. I started calling it the Guest. Because it arrived after me, and now it walks around the house like it owns it. I hit it once with my sword. It vanished. It came back closer.
diario.sussurros.pagina.8: Day 26. Today it opened the door the way I open it. Stopped at the threshold the way I stop. It isn't hunting me. It's studying me. It wants to know what it's like to be me.
diario.sussurros.pagina.9: Day 29. It vanished by the window and left a pale dust on the floor. Not sand, bone or fireplace ash. It was cold. I kept some. If it can leave traces, maybe I can study it too.
message.sussurros.diario.em_branco: The remaining pages are blank. Or someone tore them out before you.
message.sussurros.sussurro.8: ...you walk so nicely... let me try...
message.sussurros.sussurro.9: ...almost time for me to be you...
message.sussurros.irritado: ...you're not afraid of me, %s? let's change that...
message.sussurros.vela.acendeu: A pale flame surrounds you. For now, you are safe.
message.sussurros.vela.ja_acesa: A pale flame is already burning.
message.sussurros.olho.revelou: The eye fixes on something %s you. %s blocks.
message.sussurros.olho.nada: The eye finds nothing. For now.
message.sussurros.olho.atencao: The eye finds nothing... but something blinked back.
message.sussurros.acordar.mesma_cama: You always sleep here, %s. I like to watch.
message.sussurros.acordar.observado: You wake up feeling someone was watching.
message.sussurros.visto: ...you saw me, %s. i saw you too...
itemTooltip.sussurros.cinza_palida: Far too cold to have come from a fire.
itemTooltip.sussurros.sino_oco: It has no clapper. Something answers anyway.
itemTooltip.sussurros.fio_vigilia: It does not stop passage. It only proves something crossed.
diario.sussurros.pagina.10: Day 31. I made a bell with no clapper using the dust. When I shook it, I did not hear the bell. I heard an answer in the hallway. Hours later the answer came from somewhere I had walked before. The third time, nothing answered. I think it can lie too.
diario.sussurros.pagina.11: Day 34. I dragged string through the dust and stretched it across the floor. It is not a barrier. Tonight the thread snapped. I was staring at it. I saw nothing cross.
diario.sussurros.pagina.12: Day 38. The candle repels. The eye searches. The bell asks. The thread confirms. For the first time I felt like I was learning something about it too. That lasted until I noticed it started avoiding the places where I prepared everything.
diario.sussurros.pagina.13: Day ?? — if you are reading this, it already knows your name, %s. Do not always sleep in the same place. Do not trust every answer. Do not assume a tool works the same way twice. It remembers where you sleep. It remembers everything.
message.sussurros.fio.armado: The thread almost disappears against the floor. Now you wait.
message.sussurros.fio.ja_armado: A vigil thread is already armed.
itemTooltip.sussurros.isca_palida: Choose the place. It decides whether to come.
message.sussurros.isca.armada: The ash clings to the ground. The place has a scent for it now.
message.sussurros.isca.ja_armada: A Pale Bait is already waiting.
message.sussurros.olho.vestigio: The eye does not find the creature. It stares at a mark %s you. %s blocks.
diario.sussurros.pagina.14: Day 41. I mixed the ash with string, bone and rotten flesh. Left a small bundle where I wanted to see it. The first night it appeared almost on top of it. The second, farther away. The third, the bundle stayed untouched. It learns even our traps.
diario.sussurros.pagina.15: Day 44. I saw the face on the other side of the window. Not the whole body. Just a crooked head and two pale points where its eyes should be. When I got out of bed it was gone. There was ash outside.
diario.sussurros.pagina.16: Day 47. The eye does not show only it. Sometimes it points to places where it was. The snapped thread, the hallway where it vanished, marks on the floor. Maybe the world keeps something of it after it leaves.
diario.sussurros.pagina.17: Day 51. I made the mistake of thinking the tools were mine. The candle taught it where not to enter. The bell taught it when to lie. The bait taught it where I wanted it to stand. The thread taught it what I watch. I was not studying it alone. I was filling out a questionnaire.
itemTooltip.sussurros.caderno_vestigios: Writing it down is one way to notice what changed.
message.sussurros.caderno.nivel.0: There is not enough proof yet. Only coincidences that started repeating.
message.sussurros.caderno.nivel.1: There is matter where it has been. The world keeps marks after it leaves.
message.sussurros.caderno.nivel.2: Places matter. Tools, routes and structures are starting to form a pattern.
message.sussurros.caderno.nivel.3: You can provoke answers now. That does not mean you are still the one conducting the experiment.
diario.sussurros.pagina.18: Day 55. The cows went still at the same time. None were looking at me. All of them stared at the same tree. I waited for it to appear. Nothing did. That was worse.
diario.sussurros.pagina.19: Day 58. A torch appeared ahead in the tunnel. I did not place it. When I got close it went out, and the one behind me was gone too. In the morning mine was back.
diario.sussurros.pagina.20: Day 63. I found a stone-and-wood watch post on a road I swear I know. There were notes, ash and signs of someone who spent hours watching the same valley. Maybe I am not the first. Maybe the place was not there yesterday.
diario.sussurros.pagina.21: Day 67. The worst part is not when it appears. It is when the world does something it would only do if it knew I was watching. Animals, lights, doors, paths. I no longer know where the Guest ends and the place begins.
